item.description: Liverpool linked defender told to fight for place Liverpool Return Unlikely as Trent Alexander-Arnold Makes Real Madrid Decision Trent Alexander-Arnold’s difficult start to life at Real Madrid has inevitably prompted speculation about a possible return to Liverpool. Yet the England international appears determined to persevere in Spain, convinced that his opportunity will eventually arrive. Having departed Liverpool to pursue a new chapter at Real Madrid, Trent finds himself confronting an unfamiliar challenge. Regular football, once almost guaranteed at Anfield, has become increasingly difficult to secure under Jose Mourinho. Despite suggestions that a January transfer could offer an escape route, the defender reportedly remains committed to establishing himself at the Santiago Bernabeu. Trent Determined to Fight for Real Madrid Future Speaking on talkSPORT , as reported by Spanish football journalist Guillem Balague dismissed the prospect of Alexander-Arnold seeking a January departure. “No, not in January,” Balague explained. “What he’s feeling right now is ‘Okay, it’s not my time, but it will be my time, I will prepare for my time’. That’s how he’s taking the whole thing. For a player whose decision to leave Liverpool carried considerable emotional weight, abandoning the project so quickly would represent another significant career decision. Alexander-Arnold clearly believes his qualities can eventually earn him a regular position within Mourinho’s side. Patience, however, may prove essential. Photo: IMAGO Real Madrid Competition Creates Growing Frustration Real Madrid’s considerable squad depth has complicated Trent’s attempts to establish himself. Balague outlined the extent of the competition confronting the former Liverpool defender. “But there are two ahead of him in the same position [Fede Valverde and Denzel Dumfries] and in fact, Eder Militao was also used as a right back against Sevilla. So is he fourth choice? He’s certainly third it seems. The situation has become particularly frustrating because Alexander-Arnold has occasionally been deployed in midfield when opportunities have arisen. “But he’s not down, he’s been told by Mourinho to keep at it, he will have his moment. It’s been unfair that when he has played from the start, he has played in the midfield because of the absentees. “But in any case, he’s got to keep fighting and he wants to succeed at Real Madrid, so he’s got no intention of leaving.” Liverpool Return Remains an Intriguing Possibility For Liverpool supporters, Trent’s struggles at Real Madrid will inevitably generate discussion about whether a reunion could eventually become realistic. item.title: Pirate hire former Astros pitching coach for Minor Leagues
item.description: SCOTTSDALE, AZ - OCTOBER 04: Pitching coach Sean Buchanan of the Surprise Saguaros poses for a photo during the 2024 Surprise Saguaros Photo Day at Scottsdale Stadium on Friday, October 4, 2024 in Scottsdale, Arizona. (Photo by Jennifer Stewart/MLB Photos via Getty Images) | MLB Photos via Getty Images The Pittsburgh Pirates made an offseason change to the coaching staff, hiring former Houston Astro pitching coach Sean Buchanan, according to The Athletic. The Astros are losing Triple-A pitching coach Sean Buchanan to the Pittsburgh Pirates, sources tell @TheAthletic . Buchanan’s exact role is still being determined, but he will reunite with longtime Astros pitching coach Bill Murphy in Pittsburgh. — Chandler Rome (@Chandler_Rome) October 27, 2026 The Bucs will reportedly use Buchanan in the upper levels of the Minor Leagues, which would make sense with Buchanan coming over from Triple-A in the Astros program. There with the Sugar Land Space Cowboys, Buchanan helped lead the team to the fewest runs allowed in the league, with the third-lowest ERA at 4.97, along with the lowest BAA at .248, and they had nine shutouts, the most in the PCL. During his five years with the Astros organization, he’s also spent time with Double-A Corpus Christi in 2024, High-A Asheville in 2023 and Astros Blue in 2022. Before that, he also spent some time with Lehigh, Albright College, Bard College, SUNY New Paltz, DeSales University, and Ave Maria University. Buchanan comes with a good reputation and this is considered a bit of a steal for the Bucs for their Minor League system. And the Bucs must like what they see in the Astros system, taking their second coach from Houston in as many years after Bill Murphy came to Pittsburgh last year. Nevertheless, the Bucs have a strong pitching staff at both the Major and Minor League levels, so it’s understandable why it’s an attractive job. And keep an eye on Buchanan in the Minors next year. We could end up seeing him in the Majors at some point.

item.title: Madison girls soccer celebrating milestones, prepping for playoffs
item.description: Madison girls soccer coach Marc Dovico earned his 200th career victory as Madison defeated Kinnelon, 7-1, on the road on Oct. 26. The Dodgers celebrated senior goalkeeper Antonia Waddington's 300th save, as well as Dovico's milestone, at practice on Oct. 27. Madison earned its fourth straight division title this fall, with the NJSIAA Tournament set to begin on Nov. 3. The team is aiming at its third straight North 2 Group 2 title. Dovico coached the Whippany Park girls for 10 seasons, earning two conference titles and two sectional titles, then shifted to Madison. "I've been surrounded by coaches who have won lots of games," said Dovico, who is also president of the Morris County Girls Soccer Coaches' Association. "It's not something I strive for, but I see the longevity and the time they put in. ... It's good to have people around you who have had success." Dovico grew up in Bloomfield, where he played left back "and a little center back" and basketball. Current Madison volleyball coach Stephen Fenton was one of his phys ed teachers. Though Bloomfield didn't qualify for the NJSIAA Tournament in Dovico's senior season, he "realized coaching was something I'd be interested in doing" during high school. Dovico graduated from Syracuse University with a degree in history. His first high school coaching job was as an assistant to Whippany Park legend Tom Wilson with the boys soccer team. "I don't remember him applying for the job. I don't remember an interview process. I just remember being pretty fortunate," Wilson said. "He's a student of the game. He puts in more time by far than the average person. By the time you get to the end of the season, he's probably seen every single possible opponent play. He figures out who he's going to see in the state tournament run, every Morris County team, so when he does play them, he can adjust every game plan he typically plays with for who he's going to play. He can make specific moves that will increase his team's chances for success." More: Madison milestone, tourney highlights and boys soccer Super 10 rankings While Dovico kept the milestone pretty quiet, he was excited to share it with some of his former players via a group chat. He has also begun sprouting his own coaching tree. West Morris junior varsity coach John McCormack, an English teacher, was on his first team at Whippany Park 21 years ago. New Villa Walsh soccer coaches Marc DiFalco and Mark Prosicki also played for the Wildcats. Whippany Park alumna Savanna Marcantonio is the freshman girls coach at Mendham. "I wouldn't be doing it as long as I did if I didn't enjoy it," said Dovico, who is also an assistant coach with Madison's girls basketball program. "Every season's different. I love the routine of it. I love the atmosphere of high school athletics. I still believe in high school athletics and what it offers kids." item.title: Kovac calls for a wonder goal: „Totally crazy!“
item.description: Kovac calls for a wonder goal: „Totally crazy!“ Not only did Kovac bring on the experienced midfielder in the 71st minute with the score at 2-2, putting his faith in him for the closing stages. He also urged Dortmund’s number 20 to go for goal with the final kick of the three minutes of stoppage time. “It was totally crazy. Schlotti (Nico Schlotterbeck, editor’s note) had actually told Sabi (Marcel Sabitzer) to let Daniel (Svensson) put in a cross, meaning the ball would be played away from goal. Then I shouted from the touchline: ‘Sabi, please shoot!’ Because I know what a shot he has on him. He listened to his coach, and he deserves praise for that,” Kovac told ZDF, recalling his flash of inspiration. Sabitzer said of his coach’s instruction: “I heard something from the touchline. The coach told me to shoot. That made me even more determined to do it. Schlotti was still waving it off inside the penalty area, but I told him afterwards: Never do that again — you saw what happened.” Borussia Dortmund are through to the last 16 of the DFB-Pokal, thanks in part to Sabitzer’s direct free-kick goal . item.title: Alonso backs Chelsea summer signing to fill Joao Pedro void
item.description: Alonso backs Chelsea summer signing to fill Joao Pedro void Xabi Alonso has confirmed Chelsea will be without Joao Pedro for several weeks due to a thigh issue, but has backed summer signing Emmanuel Emegha to help fill the void. Emegha is yet to debut for Chelsea since signing from Strasbourg in the summer, due to injury. The Dutchman has returned to training and could make his first appearance against Liverpool in the Carabao Cup this evening. Emegha scored 31 goals in 78 games across three seasons at Strasbourg and Alonso is excited to have the 6ft 5in forward among his options, alongside fellow recruit Danny Welbeck. The Spaniard said Emegha has ‘special qualities’ and has backed the forward to make an impression. “For sure it’s important that we have him available because he has special qualities,’ said Alonso in his pre-match press conference. “He needs to feel fully fit. He has been training for the last two weeks, ten days, in a good way that has allowed him to build a strong base of fitness. “Now, gradually, we want to see him and maybe tomorrow he has the chance to play.” Morgan Rogers operated at centre-forward during the defeat to Tottenham at the weekend and Alonso is adamant that Chelsea have multiple options to combat the loss of Pedro. “There are the strikers, but there are other players that can play in that position,” he said. “We need to find the right balance between the things they are good at and how they connect with the other players. We tried with Morgan playing close to Cole [Palmer], and sometimes we need to be creative and try a few things to see if they are going to work well. “I assess all the possibilities we have and what we have been preparing during the week, and with the qualities all players have, to choose the best team for each game. item.title: Kuyt named Fenerbahce interim boss ahead of Liverpool tie
item.description: Kuyt won 104 caps for the Netherlands [Getty Images] Former Netherlands forward Dirk Kuyt has been appointed Fenerbahce's interim coach a week before they face his former club Liverpool in the Champions League. The 46-year-old is stepping up to the role after being the assistant of Ismail Kartal, who resigned as the Turkish club's manager following the side's 2-1 defeat by arch rivals Galatasaray on Monday. Fenerbahce said Kuyt, who won the Turkish league title with the club as a player in 2013-14, would hold the post "until a new head coach is appointed". Kuyt's first game will be a league match against Goztepe on Saturday before Fenerbahce host Liverpool in a Champions League group stage tie on Wednesday, 4 November (17:45 GMT). The Dutchman spent six years with the Anfield side, winning the League Cup with the Reds in 2012 and scoring 71 goals for them in 285 appearances. He went on to have a three-year stint at Fenerbahce and, after a spell at Feyenoord, retired as a player in 2017. Kuyt held managerial posts at ADO Den Haag, Beerschot and FC Dordrecht before becoming Fenerbahce assistant in June 2026. Kartal had previously stepped down as manager in September but had stayed in the post after his resignation, on that occasion, was not accepted. Kuyt takes over with Fenerbahce fifth in the Turkish top-flight and six points behind leaders Galatasaray. item.title: Real Madrid issue official apology to China after Mbappe’s remarks
item.description: Real Madrid issue official apology to China after Mbappe’s remarks Real Madrid have found themselves in a tough spot following Kylian Mbappe’s recent comments, where he joked about how he found the depiction of him as Mao Dezong funny. Mbappe’s comments led to an upheaval in China with several sponsors cancelling deals with the French star, including Dongpeng Beverage, Mengniu and Milkground. Beyond that, China has officially decided to suspend the broadcast of La Liga in the country, leading to a major concern. Mbappe was ultimately forced to issue an apology following the uproar, as he acknowledged having hurt sentiments in China. Real Madrid also issue apology A day later, Real Madrid, too, have now issued an apology to China. As representative of the player, the club have apologised to the people of China in behalf of Mbappe for having hurt the sentiment of the community. “Real Madrid C.F. wishes to apologize to the Chinese people for any distress that may have been caused by the recent remarks made by our player, Kylian Mbappe,” the club wrote in a statement. “Our club holds deep respect for China—its history, its culture, and its citizens—as well as for the millions of Chinese fans who feel affection and admiration for Real Madrid ,” the club added. Real Madrid added that the club joins Mbappe in asking for apology for the comments the Frenchman mate in connection to the meme. “ The club joins in the public apology offered by Kylian Mbappe, in which the player himself has expressed regret for his words and reiterated his respect for the Chinese people. “Real Madrid reaffirms its commitment to the values ​​of respect, coexistence, and cross-cultural understanding, and expresses its desire to continue strengthening the bonds of friendship and affection that connect it to China and its citizens ,” the club wrote. A pain for Real Madrid as well Mbappe’s comments have caused an uproar in China. (Photo by Alex Caparros/Getty Images) A key reason why Real Madrid have also decided to get involved in this entire saga is because the club have also been hurt by the fallout of Mbappe’s comments. As is the norm, the club earns a significant portion from the player’s image rights and China is a key market for the club, with the nation having a strong following for Mbappe. Losing out on revenue and drawing the ire of the Chinese people were never going to make sense for Real Madrid, who have taken a more globalist approach in recent years, trying to build their fan base across the world. China is also an important economy for sponsorships and reach. Real Madrid cannot risk losing that at any cost.

item.title: Jeff Teague apologises to Cooper Flagg, says he ‘might be LeBron’
item.description: Photo by Katelyn Mulcahy/Getty Images Cooper Flagg had a huge game for the Dallas Mavericks as they beat the Miami Heat in their last matchup. His performance has drawn an apology from former NBA star Jeff Teague. Cooper Flagg has entered his sophomore season with a lot of expectations on his shoulders. Although the Dallas Mavericks aren’t necessarily thought of as contenders in the Western Conference, fans and the media alike want to see Flagg taking the next step. Flagg was named Rookie of the Year last season, an award he definitely earned. While most have hyped him since he was in high school, there have also been some non-believers. That list includes former NBA All-Star Jeff Teague. But Coop now has his detractors eating their words. Jeff Teague apologises for saying Cooper Flagg would be like Andrei Kirilenko, compares him to LeBron James In the Mavericks’ recent win against the Miami Heat, Flagg had 29 points, six rebounds, and 11 assists. Those are excellent numbers for a player in his position. What’s more, he also got the clutch bucket which sealed a narrow 113-109 victory for his team. Teague has spoken about it on his Club 520 podcast, not backing down from admitting that he may have been wrong. “I wanna apologise to Cooper Flagg,” Teague said. “Brother, I said you was gonna be Kirilenko. Boy, you about to be LeBron. Bro, he is cold… Please forgive me. Because Cooper Flagg, you Scottie Pippen, you a mixture… I know you good cuz Dallas done forgotten about Luka.” This is high praise from Teague, especially the names he has compared Flagg to. It is on the 19-year-old to keep growing at the pace he currently is. For now, he looks like he’s going to be a problem in the league for years to come. And if he can have even half of LeBron’s career, that would make him one of the all-time greats. item.title: Real Madrid legend praises Jose Mourinho’s Clasico masterclass: ‘They played exceptionally well’
item.description: Real Madrid legend praises Jose Mourinho’s Clasico masterclass: ‘They played exceptionally well’ Real Madrid’s 2-1 victory over Barcelona has restored confidence around the Santiago Bernabeu after a difficult period against their biggest rivals. Jose Mourinho’s side not only secured three important points but also showcased a level of tactical organisation that had been missing in recent Clasicos . As quoted by Diario AS , former Real Madrid midfielder Toni Kroos has praised Mourinho’s work, particularly in Sunday’s game. Kroos credits Mourinho for changing Real Madrid’s approach Kroos identified the Portuguese manager as the main reason for Sunday’s victory at the Spotify Camp Nou . “Over the last two years, the Clasicos had been going Barcelona’s way,” Kroos said, acknowledging Madrid’s struggles in previous meetings. “But that has changed, and I have to praise Mourinho’s work. They played exceptionally well, and he prepared the match brilliantly.” Toni Kroos had huge words of praise for Jose Mourinho. (Photo by Alex Caparros/Getty Images) The German was particularly impressed by Madrid’s bravery in possession and their defensive organisation. He singled out Dean Huijsen’s marking of Fermin Lopez and the pressure applied to Barcelona’s midfield. “Players like Pedri and Raphinha looked uncomfortable, and Madrid forced them into mistakes they don’t normally make,” he explained. Kroos also praised the team’s intensity, adding: “Real Madrid defended as a team. They played an excellent match defensively and with the ball.” He believes Mourinho successfully exploited Barcelona’s difficulties when their pressing system fails, preventing Flick’s men from enjoying their usual control. Kroos sends message to Vinicius and praises Mbappe The former midfielder also discussed Vinicius Junior’s absence, admitting he would have enjoyed watching the Brazilian exploit the space behind Joao Cancelo. item.title: Hansi Flick set to field new defensive back four against Alaves as injury crisis deepens
item.description: Hansi Flick set to field new defensive back four against Alaves as injury crisis deepens Barcelona manager Hansi Flick is preparing to field a significantly altered defence against Alaves this weekend after injuries left several of his regular defenders unavailable, according to Mundo Deportivo . The 1-2 El Clasico defeat brought another setback with Xavi Espart joining Eric Garcia , Andreas Christensen and Jules Kounde on the injury list, leaving Flick with limited options for Saturday’s La Liga fixture. Of the aforementioned, Kounde is the only injured defender who could recover in time for the match , although his availability remains uncertain. Regardless of whether the Frenchman returns, Barcelona are expected to deploy a defensive combination that differs from their most frequently used back four this season. Barcelona injuries leaves Flick with limited defensive options Kounde sustained an ankle sprain during Barcelona’s league match against Real Betis, and Flick is hopeful that the right-back can recover before the Alaves game, but his fitness will determine whether he can be included from the start. Christensen is expected to miss the weekend fixture after suffering an injury to the rectus femoris muscle in his left thigh against Sevilla. Xavi Epsart picked up an injury against Real Madrid. (Photo by Alex Caparros/Getty Images) As reported before, the Danish defender could instead target Barcelona’s meeting with Atletico Madrid on November 8. Eric Garcia faces a longer recovery after injuring the rectus femoris in his right thigh during the Betis match. Espart’s latest setback further reduces Flick’s options, creating a difficult selection problem at both full-back positions and in central defence. Flick faces new Barcelona defence selection dilemma For now, Pau Cubarsi and Gerard Martíi have been the preferred centre-back pairing, but the injuries around them complicate the positions on either side. Kounde has featured at right-back this season, while Espart has also been used on the left. Hansi Flick will field a new defence against Alaves. (Photo by Alex Caparros/Getty Images) Joao Cancelo has offered another option, although he has not started at right-back in any of Barcelona’s 13 competitive matches. Alejandro Balde’s limited involvement adds another complication. The academy graduate has played only 86 minutes across three matches and has not started at left-back during that run. Flick could therefore have to rely on players who have not regularly occupied their expected positions. Using another versatile option, such as Brian Farinas , would represent an additional experiment rather than a settled solution. Barcelona have already used 10 different defenders this season, which shows how frequently Flick has had to adjust his back line and against Alaves, there will be a new back four.

item.title: Giants’ Super Bowl Champion Sends Message to Dominic Zvada
item.description: Dominic Zvada #34 of the New York Giants looks dejected on the sideline after missing a field goal in overtime against the Washington Commanders at Northwest Stadium. Getty Before the season started, it felt like the New York Giants had something special on their hands with their young kicker. Undrafted free agent Dominic Zvada was an early standout in training camp and preseason, nailing all five of his field goal attempts and all four of his extra-point attempts throughout New York’s preseason. Even once the real games began, the former Michigan kicker was lights out for Big Blue. He was perfect through the first four games of his career, drilling nine straight field goal tries. Then disaster struck in Week 5, when the rookie went 2-for-5 against the Washington Commanders. He’s been shaky at best ever since. But all is not lost for Zvada, and he received a vote of confidence from longtime Giants kicker Lawrence Tynes. Lawrence Tynes Sends Encouraging Message to Dominic Zvada As the New York Giants head into their bye week, Zvada is going to get the chance to reset and refine some of the things that have gone wrong with his game. He’ll also want to read this message from Tynes, who knows a thing or two as a two-time champion as the Giants’ kicker. “John Harbaugh is an expert with kickers. He knows the position better than any head coach in football. He literally had two kickers in his 19 seasons at Baltimore who are both borderline Hall of Famers (Stover and Tucker),” wrote Tynes in a long post on X. “ Dominic Zvada is going to be an elite NFL kicker for many years. The Giants know what they have in him, he’s a rare talent. There are going to be some bumps along the way but missing 57, 56, and 50 yarders is 100% excusable for a rookie.” Sure, Tynes has some blue-tinted glasses on thanks to his time with Big Blue, but he isn’t just blowing smoke here. He did offer some advice to the Giants coaching staff to get Zvada back in a groove. “Only thing I would change is stop putting him out there for 55+ yd FG’s unless it is end of game of or end of half situation for the time being. He needs to keep building his confidence and missing from any distance dents that along with the media scrutiny,” continued Tynes. “I am a huge fan of this young man. We cannot make the mistake of letting him out the building like we did with future Hall of Famer Chris Boswell PIT in 2015. Patience is required. Go Big Blue!” We’ll see if the Giants and/or Zvada end up taking him up on this advice. Giants Have No Plans to Move on From Dominic Zvada At his pre-bye press conference, John Harbaugh was asked if the New York Giants were planning on bringing in any kickers for a workout as insurance for the struggling Zvada. His answer was short and to the point, indicating just how much faith the team still has in the rookie kicker. “We’re not going to be doing that right now, no,” Harbaugh responded. item.description: Motorsport photo One of the most remarkable moments on Sunday in Austin did not take place on the track itself, but rather in the Formula 1 paddock after the US Grand Prix. During the usual post-race media sessions, both Aston Martin and Red Bull’s representatives were asked about a subject that had very little to do with the race at the Circuit of the Americas – quite the opposite, in fact. Both Aston Martin's chief trackside officer Mike Krack and Red Bull team principal Laurent Mekies were asked whether they could rule out a potential partnership between the two brands in the future. It seems rather extraordinary, and both men understandably looked surprised when that question randomly came up during their media rounds, which is why the matter requires some context. It all goes back to a BBC article and a somewhat unfortunate interpretation of it. In the regular Q&A column of F1 correspondent Andrew Benson, he was asked whether customer teams might be interested in the Red Bull Ford power unit, given that it appears to be more than competitive in its first year. The answer made it abundantly clear that no F1 team is currently looking for a power unit and then rightly highlighted something that is widely known in the paddock: the shock at Aston Martin, particularly for team owner Lawrence Stroll, when it became apparent earlier this year just how far behind Honda was on the power unit side at the start of F1’s new era. That understandably led to some initial doubts and considerations, although the decision was made to remain fully committed to Honda – something the BBC article also correctly emphasised. The only speculative element that left the door slightly open was the possibility that those doubts could resurface if Honda fails to make the expected step forward in, let’s say, 2027 or 2028. As so often happens in F1 and today's media landscape, the story subsequently took on a life of its own and became a bigger talking point than it should have been, according to several insiders. It is a self-fulfilling prophecy: something automatically becomes a topic, rightly or wrongly, if enough people in the F1 paddock are asked about it, which in turn generates coverage. It is a snowball effect, making it crucial to put such stories into perspective. The Aston Martin perspective: Abandoning works deal potential would be extremely premature Both Krack and Mekies were asked on Sunday evening whether they could deny that talks were taking place between Aston Martin and Red Bull Powertrains, with the implication of that question naturally going considerably further than anything suggested in the original BBC article. Krack was quick to reaffirm Aston Martin's long-term commitment to Honda. item.title: Japan football official quits over World Cup row
item.description: Takeshi Okada coached Japan at the 1998 and 2010 World Cups (JOHN MACDOUGALL) The vice president of Japan's football association quit on Wednesday saying the "series of responses" to controversies surrounding the World Cup did not align with his personal values. Takeshi Okada, who coached Japan at the World Cup in 1998 and again in 2010, stepped down a week after the head of Asian football said the region supported Gianni Infantino's bid for re-election as FIFA president. Asian Football Confederation (AFC) president Sheikh Salman bin Ebrahim al-Khalifa delivered the unequivocal backing at a meeting in Tokyo. It came weeks after the AFC had joined football bodies in Europe and North America in condemning Infantino over his plan to open FIFA's premium competitions such as the World Cup to private investors. Infantino has faced calls to quit and lost the support of some associations in his bid to be re-elected to a fourth and final term. Okada, who is one of three Japan Football Association (JFA) vice presidents, said he was stepping down "entirely of my own volition". "Throughout my career I have treasured the social value of sport based on my conviction that sport must be conducted with integrity," he said. "However, with regard to the series of responses surrounding the recent FIFA World Cup, there is a significant gap between those responses and my own beliefs, and as a sportsman I cannot accept them." Infantino, who apologised for the failed private investment project, has headed FIFA since 2016 and is running for re-election in March. Two months ago the AFC and Sheikh Salman signalled they could turn on Infantino. A joint letter with European body UEFA and CONCACAF, representing federations in North and Central America and the Caribbean, declared football "belongs to no individual". Okada said his decision had been "reached after careful and repeated deliberation". "Taking into account our relationship with the AFC and the impact on Japanese football, I do understand that there are practical reasons for aligning our stance with that of the AFC," he said. amk/pst

item.title: Prakash Bhatt becomes second Indian after Javagal Srinath to be Test match referee
item.description: MUMBAI: Former Saurashtra cricketer Prakash Bhatt on Wednesday made his ‘Test debut’ in Mirpur, Dhaka, in the first Test between Bangladesh and West Indies as a ICC match referee. Bhatt has thus become only the second Indian after ex-India pacer Javagal Srinath to become a match referee in Tests. In April this year, Bhatt had been chosen by the International Cricket Council in a newly created three-member Emerging panel of ICC international match referees. The ICC has an 'Elite panel' which has five match referees (Javagal Srinath, Andy Pycroft, Richie Richardson, Ranjan Madugalle and Jeff Crowe), with three referees from the newly created Emerging panel added to the list. The development meant that the ICC would post Bhatt to officiate in plenty of international games, including Test matches. Bhatt has been a BCCI match referee in domestic cricket since the 2007-2008 season. He has been an IPL match referee since 2018. He has been with the ICC since 2024. He is the first Indian to be included in the inaugural ICC Emerging panel of Match Referees. In his international career so far, Bhatt has officiated in 48 T20Is, six ODIs, four Women’s T20Is and three Women’s ODIs. He has also officiated in 67 first-class matches and 75 IPL matches so far. The 56-year-old Bhatt officiated in 13 matches in the Under-19 ODI World Cup held in Jan-Feb in Zimbabwe and Namibia. In Oct last year, Bhatt officiated in the Australia versus New Zealand T20I series in New Zealand. Bhatt played 51 first-class matches (3,183 runs at 39.29, seven centuries) and 38 List A matches (1,007 runs at 33.56, six fifties) between 1994-95 and 2004-05.

item.description: “How dare he go out and say that”: Peter Schmeichel tears into Erik ten Hag over “ridiculous” Man United claim Manchester United legend Peter Schmeichel has criticised former manager Erik ten Hag over his recent controversial remarks about the club. Ten Hag’s assessment Ten Hag recently spoke at length to The Athletic about his time in charge and held nothing back. He launched a scathing attack on the football hierarchy , led by the Glazers and INEOS chairman Sir Jim Ratcliffe. Ten Hag accused the club’s leadership of fostering a “toxic” environment that made it extremely hard to succeed. The Dutch coach also revealed that he wanted to sign Harry Kane and Declan Rice , but the club could not secure the signings of the England duo. Ten Hag’s remarks came as United endure a turbulent period, with pressure mounting on Michael Carrick. The 20-time English champions are currently on an eight-match winless run. Their last victory came against minnows Sabah FK in the Champions League. United are languishing in 16th place, having gained just seven points from their opening eight matches. There was an expectation that Carrick would be sacked after the 3-0 defeat to Bournemouth, but he is set to be in charge on Saturday for the meeting with Chelsea. Speaking on The Overlap , a fuming Schmeichel accused Ten Hag of “stirring the pot” at United. Schmeichel slams Ten Hag The Dane said, “What really annoys me in everything that has happened in the past two weeks is Ten Hag coming out and saying that he wanted Declan Rice and Harry Kane, like he was a god.” “It’s so ridiculous. He brought (Lisandro) Martinez in, (Matthijs) de Ligt. I mean he brought players in that are still there, how dare he go out and say that. Everybody knew we should sign Harry Kane. Everyone knows we should have signed Declan Rice, that’s no secret. I don’t know why we didn’t do that.” Every Dutch player to play for Man United Source: Wikipedia “But you have now people stirring the pot where they should just keep calm and not talk and maybe talk about what they did for this football club themselves, or what they didn’t do. He wasn’t a success at Manchester United. Why does he feel the need to come out and say that?” Schmeichel continued, “What he’s saying is ‘I was let down by the club’ and there might be an element of truth in that but he wasn’t good enough. And then he went to Bayer Leverkusen, a team who had just won the Bundesliga, and then he got sacked within, what, three games?” “Maybe just take a step back and don’t put yourself in that because then you will end up with someone like me criticising him, and there’s no need for that. We don’t need it in the narrative.” Ten Hag was dismissed by United in October 2024 after a string of poor results left the team 14th in the Premier League.

item.title: Can clubs stop team news leaking out through FPL picks?
item.description: Joao Pedro had been pictured in training before his shock absence from Chelsea's line-up last weekend [Getty Images] Chelsea head coach Xabi Alonso was caught off guard after Saturday's loss to Tottenham when asked whether he was aware that Joao Pedro's injury had been leaked through the popular Fantasy Premier League game. His response was: "I am not into the fantasy team thing, so I didn't know that." Accounts believed by FPL trackers to belong to Chelsea staff, a player and a relative of a player appeared to transfer out or bench Joao Pedro before the deadline. One Fantasy Premier League manager, known online as FPL Karim, was among those who believed they had identified information by tracking selections made by a relative of Chelsea forward Morgan Rogers. He said: "There were rumours that a player was missing from Chelsea's attack. I went to check Rogers' team, but he'd sold Joao Pedro two or three gameweeks earlier when he was injured. He never bought him back. "Then I checked his brother's FPL team and saw that he'd sold Joao Pedro that gameweek and brought in Nicolas Jackson. I thought it was a bit weird. Why would you sell him when he's one of the most-owned forwards in the game? "That's when I felt maybe it was Joao Pedro who was missing out. I posted about it, it went viral, and that was basically it." Confirmation of the injury emerged after the FPL deadline had passed, meaning 1.7 million managers had already selected Joao Pedro as captain, which doubles a player's points return. The absence also came as a surprise to many following Chelsea's 2-0 defeat by Tottenham, given Joao Pedro had been pictured in training during the week before the match. Alonso later said the striker had missed the game because of "fluid on his thigh". 'Some players have started using aliases' Alonso is one of a number of managers who have become increasingly guarded when discussing team news in media conferences. Last month, he said: "I prefer not to give more information than needed." On that occasion, his side went on to lose 3-0 at Brentford, having kept several injury concerns, including one involving Joao Pedro, under wraps. Yet such is the popularity of Fantasy Premier League - a game played by more than 11 million people according to official figures - that many staff members, players and relatives of footballers also take part. By identifying leagues or teams linked to players, staff or family members through the game, which provides an open database of participants, it can be possible to infer what is happening behind closed doors at various training grounds. Previously, the highest-profile case involved Jack Grealish's absence from Aston Villa's match against Leicester City in February 2021. item.title: Xabi Alonso vows to celebrate Chelsea goals at Anfield amid Liverpool return
item.description: Xabi Alonso vows to celebrate Chelsea goals at Anfield amid Liverpool return Xabi Alonso has said he will 'celebrate, for sure' if Chelsea score against Liverpool at Anfield tonight, but insisted his bond with his former club remains intact. Alonso leads Chelsea into a Carabao Cup last-16 tie on Merseyside, his first trip back to Anfield as Blues manager. It is the third club he has taken there in as many seasons, with the Spaniard beaten on each previous visit. In November 2024, his Bayer Leverkusen side were beaten 4-0 by Arne Slot's Liverpool in the Champions League league phase. A year later he returned with Real Madrid at the same stage and lost again, with Alexis Mac Allister's second-half header deciding the game. As a player, Alonso spent five years at Anfield between 2004 and 2009, making 210 appearances and winning the Champions League in his first season and the FA Cup in his second. There were many Liverpool fans who felt Alonso was destined to become the club's head coach. Alonso was heavily linked with the position after Jurgen Klopp's exit in 2024, but opted to remain at Bayer Leverkusen for a further season, having led the German side to an unbeaten Bundesliga title. Alonso ultimately opted for Real Madrid when leaving Germany, but was linked again with Anfield earlier this year after being sacked at the Bernabeu. As Arne Slot's reign came to its conclusion, the 44-year-old was named as a leading candidate to replace him. Instead, he took the Chelsea job. It remains to be seen how Alonso is greeted this evening. There has been a warm welcome for the former midfielder on past visits, but his appointment at a major domestic rival complicates the relationship. Another sub-plot is the presence of Andoni Iraola in the home dugout, whose history with Alonso dates back to their childhoods in the Basque province of Gipuzkoa. Speaking to Chelsea's official website , Alonso insisted his focus is on success with his current side. "I need to support my team. I need to support my club. I fight for my club, and if we score, I will celebrate, for sure, but with respect for the opponent because my bond with Liverpool is there. But I am in a different role now." Alonso added that his winless record at Liverpool as a manager would have no bearing on tonight's tie. "It’s a different game, different competition, different club, with players that have played at Anfield many times," he said. "They know what we are expecting. It's a cup game, and there can be special moments. Some things are different in this kind of game, so I don't compare them."

item.description: A girl walks past an advertisement for an energy drink featuring French soccer player Kylian Mbappé in Wuhan, China, on July 7, 2026. —Wang He—Getty Images French soccer captain and Real Madrid forward Kylian Mbappé has apologized to China for calling Mao Zedong a “dictator,” a comment that prompted fierce criticism and institutional reprisals. “My comment was ill-judged,” Mbappé said in a statement in three languages. “I apologize to everyone my words have upset.” In a video clip from the French talk show “The Bridge” posted on Monday, Mbappé had referred to Mao as “some guy—I think he’s a Chinese dictator” as he described a meme in which his face was photoshopped onto a picture of the late founder and chairman of the Chinese Communist Party. The clip was behind-the-scenes footage from a podcast filmed in March, the podcast said. It has since been removed from the show’s social media accounts. “The Bridge” also apologized to Chinese fans, as well as to Mbappé. The meme is part of an internet trend where soccer fans have superimposed Mbappé’s face onto pictures of military and political leaders as a play on Mbappé’s nickname “the dictator,” referring to the Real Madrid player’s perceived authority and influence over football clubs and the media. Even Mbappé’s French teammate Ousmane Dembélé made a joke about the moniker during the 2026 World Cup , referring to Mbappé as Mobut after Mobutu Sese Seko, the dictator who ruled the Democratic Republic of Congo for three decades. Mbappé told French magazine L’Equipe last month that he found some of the memes funny, but that others demonstrated “a lack of political and human awareness.” “To be compared to people who murder others, or who have made millions and millions of people miserable … I don’t think I’ve ever done anything like that in my life,” he said. In the clip shared by The Bridge, Mbappé was asked which meme he finds funniest, and he pointed to the one featuring Mao. Mbappé’s “dictator” label, however, triggered sharp rebuke in China. Several Chinese broadcasters suspended coverage related to Mbappé and Spanish soccer league LaLiga, while some brands pulled ads that featured the sports star. A spokesperson for China’s Foreign Ministry said on Tuesday, before Mbappé’s apology, that “words and deeds that hurt the feelings of the Chinese people will naturally be met with opposition from all sectors of Chinese society.” Parody of Chinese leaders is politically sensitive in China, not least mockery of Mao, who founded the People’s Republic of China in 1949 and ruled the country till his death in 1976. item.description: Thierry Henry has clarified confusion surrounding his performance as Ballon d’Or presenter after attracting criticism for what he maintains were “jokes” surrounding co-presenter Kate Scott, Harry Kane and Lamine Yamal . The legendary France striker hosted ceremony for the prestigious awards in London with his CBS Sports colleague Scott, with the Champions League show’s style translating to the stage. But after correcting Scott’s pronunciation of Brazilian legend Sócrates, for which an award is named after, joking with Yamal about winning a third successive young player of the year award, despite being in contention for the main men’s award and being honest about his desire for compatriot Kylian Mbappe to beat out eventual winner Harry Kane for the main award , fans on social media criticised the former Arsenal forward’s performance. “I’ve been seeing a lot of people talking about the Ballon d’Or night and I wanted to clarify some stuff about some people getting really excited about nothing,” “First of all, Lamine Yamal, I wasn’t checking his ego at all, I just thought as the third time he’s winning that trophy, I asked him if that was the one he really wanted, and I brought out a laugh from people, we don’t know what he wanted, he didn’t get it, I’m a big fan of Lamine Yamal, I wasn’t checking his ego at all, that you didn’t like the joke, I can understand. But don’t do that, he’s one of the players I’d pay to watch, I love him, I was just asking him, if it’s the one he really wants as the real prize was coming up, unfortunately he didn’t win it, because he’s a hell of a player I’d pay to watch. “Now let’s move on to Kate, she was in on the joke, and you can ask Kate, by the way, she did it on purpose, to say Soc, and I had to say, again, you didn’t like the joke, I understand, but please stop saying I disrespected Kate, I will never do that, and you can ask her, she was on the joke with me, she did Soc on purpose, and I said Soc, so please stop inventing stories. Hosts Kate Scott and Thierry Henry on stage during the 2026 Ballon d'Or France Football award ceremony (AFP/Getty) “And the last one, if you don’t watch our show on CBS, Harry Kane, the other day, after Bayern Munich vs Arsenal, called me out for supporting Kylian Mbappe. item.title: Real Madrid face potential financial losses as Mbappe’s China controversy threatens club revenues
item.description: Real Madrid face potential financial losses as Mbappe’s China controversy threatens club revenues Real Madrid find themselves in a catch-22 situation following Kylian Mbappe’s controversy with China. The club’s commercial success depends heavily on their global appeal, which is driven by superstars like the Frenchman. These players help the club generate significant revenue through sponsorships, merchandise and image rights. Mbappe’s recent controversy in China could now have financial consequences for Los Blancos . According to Mundo Deportivo , Madrid stand to lose revenue because their agreement with Mbappe entitles the club to a percentage of his image-rights earnings. The concern follows the termination of several commercial partnerships involving the France international. Mbappe’s sponsorship losses could affect Real Madrid Mbappe earns around €30 million annually through advertising agreements, making him one of football’s most commercially valuable players. However, Chinese companies Dongpeng Beverage, Mengniu and Milkground have ended their relationships with the striker following his comments about a meme featuring former Chinese leader Mao Zedong. Madrid traditionally retain 50% of their players’ image-rights revenue, although Mbappe negotiated a more favourable arrangement, allowing him to keep a larger percentage. Nevertheless, the club still benefits financially from certain commercial agreements involving the Frenchman, meaning the loss of sponsorships will also affect the club. The exact financial damage remains unclear, particularly because the value of the terminated agreements has not been disclosed. Real Madrid’s shirt sales in China also under threat Another major concern involves merchandise sales, with China representing an important market for Real Madrid. The report estimates that approximately 15% of the club’s worldwide shirt sales come from China, while Mbappe’s No. 10 jersey is currently their best-selling shirt. A sustained backlash against the Frenchman could therefore affect demand for Madrid merchandise, potentially creating another source of lost revenue. The Mbappe situation is getting out of hand.. (Photo by Angel Martinez/Getty Images) Meanwhile, Chinese broadcaster CCTV has suspended La Liga coverage, although Mbappe has already apologised for his remarks. The broadcaster does not consider the Frenchman’s apology sufficient to change its stance on the boycott. The controversy surrounding Mbappe is quickly escalating out of control, and even La Liga president Javier Tebas is in talks to try to resolve it . The immediate priority for both the league and Real Madrid will be repairing relations with the Chinese market and limiting further damage. Otherwise, the scale of such financial losses could quickly get out of hand, and it remains to be seen how quickly the controversy subsides.
